checks.name: own delivery reads, own signoff and authored feedback are copyable after business revocation without company documents
request scope, requester identity, section cursors and operator work state apply to every page
retained legacy receipt fills a missing new-table row without duplicate observations or trusting corrupt source content
leaving the company retains personal action history and a same-request file remains subject to independent release

limitations: Own actor facts, not company order ownership
Retained legacy receipts only; lost historical observations are not reconstructed
No story text, raw media, other signers or free-text notes automatically exported
Actual JSON assembly/upload uses an operator helper; independent release and download use HTTP
